newsitem.title: UK: UK's Heron Int'l in 100 mln stg property deal.
newsitem.headline: UK's Heron Int'l in 100 mln stg property deal.

text.p: Unlisted UK property company Heron International on Wednesday unveiled a 100 million stg investment and development programme comprising four city centre projects.
Heron said three of the schemes are office/retail, two in London and one in Barcelona, while the fourth is a residential development in Madrid.

The company said construction finance is being provided by bilateral loans on individual properties from Deutsche Pfandbrief und Hypothekenbank, United Bank of Kuwait and Banco Santander. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
